notes.title: Animations & Linked Events - Playtest v0.1.0.9
notes.content:
[h2]Animations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Animation Section in Edit Selection Window
[*] Create Original Animations
[*] Play a single animation or play a whole list
[*] Local or World space option
[*] Default is playing animations at the game's start (Settings wheel in Anim. Section)
[*] Start playing an animation by using Event Actions
[/list]


[h2]Linked Events[/h2]
[list]
[*] Objects can be linked
[*] Fire an Event Action on another Object than where the Event occurred
[/list]
